comparison.objective: Stretch and hook a bungee around a carton on a cart; candidate tunes and locks a shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Elastic-cord routing and opposing hook placement versus rigid tool use, collar rotation, counterholding, and iterative cycling.
comparison.success_condition: Both hooks retained and carton survives a motion test versus repeatable controlled carriage stops and lock retention.
comparison.reason: Although both include post-operation physical testing, they validate unrelated retention and manipulation abilities.
